description: Japanese kanji tracing practice on Rokid glasses (Japanese kanji version of the trace shell): 30 common kanji with true per-stroke outline data from hanzi-writer-data (Arphic, APL), stroke order cross-checked against KanjiVG with the Japanese orders restored for 右 and 田. Frozen TR01 annotation system on hollow textbook-style glyphs: stroke-order arcs with arrows at each stroke start, numbered badges outside. Write on real paper, then a photo check for three coarse items only (missing/extra strokes, balance, most obvious differences) with the learner override, and cross-session progress.
name: Trace Kanji
